units.rawText: It is unbecoming of a man such as I to start fights unprovoked.
units.displayText: It is unbecoming of a man such as I to start fights unprovoked.

spans.text: It is unbecoming of a man such as I to start fights unprovoked.

units.rawText: But if someone I care about is endangered, my blade will be first to plunge through the enemy's throat, even if the hostile is a human... Admittedly, that's mostly because I find quarrelling to be a hassle.
